about: Places the imaging lane reads (orbit-2.52, doctrine/method.md). Launch sites that the suite's Launch program already shows in public.
Positions are GCAT's site points (sites.tsv, read 27 Nov 2026), a site's nominal centre, not a pad. A place added here must already be public on a TIC site and must name its source.
